name: Gakeppuchi Kakeibo
source:
Main character works at a company that goes bankrupt. In order to provide for his three cousins and sisters he needs a quick solution - he decides to win a mahjong tournament. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公所在的公司破产了。为了养活三个表姐妹和妹妹，他需要尽快找到解决办法，于是决定赢下麻将大赛。
